description: This file defines a Java interface for the CustomerRepository, which extends Spring Data's CrudRepository to provide CRUD operations for Customer entities stored with UUIDs. It includes a custom method to find customers by their customer number.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface providing CRUD operations for Customer entities identified by UUID, with a custom finder method for customer number.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the Customer matching the provided customer number.
